services_reason: FiatDock paid listings require a Streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint (mcpEndpoint + mcpTool). GENESIS exposes x402 HTTP routes (POST /api/flagships/*) plus a stdio MCP server (npx genesis-agent-mcp) — no hosted Streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint. A hosted MCP-over-HTTP wrapper (e.g. mcp-proxy/supergateway) would be required before publishing paid FiatDock services.
